title: CompletedMatchingRingMapSurjective
statement: Let A be a Noetherian commutative local ring [def-weil-pbc-noetherian-ring], U the open consisting exactly of the points other than its closed point, and C its maximal-ideal completion. Let q:Y\to U and s:E\to\operatorname{Spec} C be finite [def-weil-finite-integral-morphism], and D an overlap identification [def-sbc-punctured-completion-matching-sections]. The canonical map B\otimes_A C\to\Gamma(E), with B the matching ring and map as in [def-sbc-completed-matching-ring-map], is surjective.

source.place: Tags 0BLH, 05ER (the comparison, kernel and cokernel arguments), 05EU (algebra structure)

proof.text: Use the second pushout injection to give the source its C-algebra structure. The comparison is C-linear by pushout.inr_desc. Its target is finite over C because s is finite and the affine global-sections counit is an isomorphism.

Residue lifting says the comparison composed with the quotient by m_C times the target is surjective. The completion C is local. Apply Mathlib LinearMap.surjective_of_surjective_comp_mkQ and IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal_le_jacobson to obtain surjectivity of the original comparison.

proof_origin.place: 0BLH and 05ER for the residue step; 00DV (Nakayama) for the finite-module upgrade
